mat-mec-01-c2.text: Missouri University of Science and Technology (Dept. of Civil, Architectural and Environmental Engineering). Tensile Testing for Elastic Constants. Missouri S&T Lecture Notes (web.mst.edu).
mat-mec-01-c2.quote: If we know any two we can calculate the third using the relationship: E = 2 (1 + ν) G.
mat-mec-01-c2.claim: the shear modulus is G ≈ E / [2(1+ν)]. For an isotropic material these three are related, so any two suffice.
